title: Fillet corner spheres now tessellate as smooth domes, not 3-tri fans
summary: tessellate_small_spherical_cap fanned the cap pole directly to its boundary verts — fine for full spheres with many boundary samples, but for cube-corner fillet blends (3 boundary verts) it produced a visible 3-facet diamond. Switch to ring-subdivided latitude/longitude tessellation (4 rings × 12 longitudes), giving a smooth dome that matches the surrounding cylinders.
